title: 01. Fundamentals: Workshop overview
summary: Each topic includes: - Detailed theoretical explanations - Multiple practical examples - 10 hands-on exercises - 5 project ideas with implementation guidelines - Industry-ready project examples

sections.title: Topics Covered
sections.body:
### 1. **Threading Fundamentals**
- Thread creation and management
- Thread synchronization (locks, semaphores, barriers)
- Thread communication and data sharing
- Thread pools and executors
- Common threading patterns

### 2. **Multiprocessing**
- Process creation and management
- Inter-process communication (IPC)
- Process pools and executors
- Shared memory and data sharing
- Process synchronization

### 3. **Asynchronous Programming**
- Async/await syntax
- Event loops and coroutines
- Async I/O operations
- Task scheduling and management
- Concurrent async patterns

### 4. **Advanced Concurrent Patterns**
- Producer-consumer patterns
- Pipeline processing
- Map-reduce implementations
- Real-time data processing
- Distributed computing concepts

sections.title: Final Goal
sections.body:
By the end of this course, you'll be able to:
- Design and implement concurrent applications
- Choose the right concurrency model for different scenarios
- Build scalable, high-performance Python applications
- Handle real-world concurrent programming challenges

Let's begin with **Topic 1: Threading Fundamentals**!
